correction_2026_10_09: SEPARATOR CORRECTION, 2026-10-09. Every row in this file that spelled a binding `<callable>#<binding>` now spells it with `BINDING_SEP` as the family defines it — U+0000, written `\u0000` in JSON. The character was `#` until src/ast/types.ts commit c95c8485f ("the binding separator was `#` — a character nine lanes legitimately publish, so their claims were unverifiable"): `#` is a real key character in other lanes (a CSS id selector, a markdown label, an HCL address), so `verifyBindingClaim` had to reject every binding claim on a run that also published one. The edges, their lines, their confidence and their metadata are UNCHANGED; only the separator character moved. Measured before this correction: `npx tsx script/m14/run-fixtures.ts --lang dart` -> {"dart":{"pass":21,"fail":7}}, and all 7 failures were rows whose sole difference was this character. Any `#` still visible in this file's prose is the 2026-10-08 spelling quoted as history, not the current one.
correction_2026_10_08: Two rounds meet in this file. (1) Member reads whose owner is verifiable now target `Owner.member` (Store.count / Store.total). (2) A read the enclosing function BINDS now targets `<callable>#<binding>` and carries `localBinding`, because the store resolves a target by name alone: a bare `count` from `shadowed` bound to Store's field. The gate rows all still fire — the write, the declaration bind and the zero-confidence member edge are stated against spellings a regression really produces.
rationale: M49 #752 (CONV-DT-1). LIVE PROBE pre-fix: `class Store { int count = 0; int bare(){ return count; } int dotted(){ return this.count; } }` emitted uses(dotted->count) and NOTHING for the bare read — the DT-F selector branch handled only link selectors, so every plain identifier read of a declared member was invisible while the `this.` form was not. The fix adds the bare-identifier branch (mirroring java #739 and the #744 javascript bare-read block). Both gates are pinned in both directions: expectRelationships catches a dropped branch (bare/chained reads), forbidRelationships catches a missing gate — zero() is a plain-= WRITE, shadowed() binds a LOCAL count (CGD15: a local is not a member), and the field DECLARATION itself must never be read as a use.
